description: Use this when the user wants to add materials or free text to a Shopping cart list (the default list unless one is named; a new name makes that list), tick items as received or back to needed, or remove them.

category.description: A category for the items added, e.g. "Naturals".

list.description: The list to work in, by name or id. Omit for the default list.

name: shopping_list
title: Change your shopping cart
